Load orders · thresholds · data management

Data Management
Backup
Download a full backup of all orders, products, and printed history as JSON. Save the file somewhere safe (Dropbox, Google Drive, USB).
Auto-save history
The app keeps 1 automatic snapshot, refreshed every 2 hours, so you can roll back a recent mistake. Restoring one first saves your current data as the new snapshot, so you can switch back. If you ever break something, restore from a recent snapshot here. Snapshots live in this browser only — download a backup for off-device safety.
Load CSV
Upload each CSV as a complete snapshot of pending orders. Any order that was present before but isn't in the new CSV is treated as shipped — its parts are automatically subtracted from inventory. New orders get added to the queues.
[ + ]
Drop CSV here
or click to browse · expects columns: Order Date, Item Name, Quantity, Item SKU, Recipient

Queue priority thresholds
Orders older than these thresholds get pushed to the top of the queue (below Part Needed cards). Bump these UP when you're catching up to keep the queue manageable; bump them DOWN to surface more late orders. Drag the sliders, then tap Save Thresholds to apply.
Standard orders 18 days
Ship-promise: 15-20 business days (you state 20 on your site)
Vehicle orders 28 days
Ship-promise: 30-45 business days (you state 30-45 on your site)
